player_prompt.intro:
U ena le Player {player_id} ka **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Romella kopo ya hao e le **[macro  micro]** (dinomoro tse pedi 0-8):
• *macro*  = u rata mini-bodi u tlo bapala ka yona
• *micro* = u rata sekwere e ka hare ho mini-bodi eo
Mohlahla `[7 8]` ➜ bea lebollo la hao mini-bodi 7, sekwere 8, mme
kganela motjha wa hao hore a bapale mini-bodi 8 e tlang.

U ena le `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ho falla ho tlameha hore e be ka sebōpeho sa [macro micro] se nang le linomoro tsa 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Lenane ka leng le tlameha ho ba pakeng tsa 0 le 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row kapa col e ka ntle ho range.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Sele e se ntse e hapiloe.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Sebapali se lokela ho bapala boto e latelang ea micro.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Boto ea micro e se e hapiloe.

next_board.any: boto efe kapa efe e nyane ea micro board

game_action.played: Player {player_id} o ile a bapala mini-bodi {macro_idx}, sekwere {micro_idx} (rara {row}, kolone {col}). Player {opponent_id} o tlameha ho bapala {nxt_txt} hona joale.

outcome.win: Sebapali {player_id} se hapa Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
